claim: DFW completed six modular structural moves for Terminal F in August 2025, with modules approaching the size of a football field, transported overnight via self-propelled modular transporters along an airside taxiway; it is DFW's third project using modular terminal construction.
source_title: Terminal F Construction Milestone
supporting_excerpt: On Aug. 8, the airport completed the last of six module moves that make up the structure for Terminal F. The modules, some nearly as large as a football field, were moved overnight during a two-week period using self-propelled modular transporters along one of DFW's airside taxiways. This is DFW's third project to deploy the innovative module-based method to reconstruct or expand its terminal facilities.
